markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (86%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
Flagged (tier 3) because the 90% prediction set includes both Benign and InSitu [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 86%, InSitu 13%, Normal 1%, Invasive 0% | Favors benign; negligible invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (alpha 10%) | Cannot exclude in situ carcinoma |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability / 90th percentile OOD [F6] | Atypical OOD; passes quality control |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent models match top class |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign, 2/5 Normal, 1/5 InSitu [F5] | Reference neighbors are split |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.40 contribution), 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.40 contribution) pushes away from invasion [F3] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 2, 3) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.39 contribution), 0/20 AI spot check [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 1, 6, 10) · ↓ invasive · Elevated score (-0.36 contribution) favors duct-confined growth · Weak
- **Tumor cell fraction and density** (regions 0, 5, 11) · context · 86% neoplastic nuclei (100th percentile) [F7]; 3659/mm² (97th percentile) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-risk regions drops invasive probability more than random (95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); mitoses and normal lobules are Unreliable (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- In situ carcinoma (13% probability, inside the conformal set) is present in regions 1, 5, 6, or 10.
- High neoplastic cell counts in region 5 (231 nuclei; 48% tile risk) reflect true atypical or in situ proliferation.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 5**: Inspect the highest-risk tile (48% risk, 231 neoplastic nuclei) for architectural atypia, mitoses, or necrosis.
2. **Regions 1, 6, 10**: Review duct-confined epithelium; consider drafted CK5/6, ER stains and deeper levels for atypia vs in situ.
3. **Regions 0, 5, 11**: Check whether HoVer-Net neoplastic calls and 92nd-percentile immune proximity [F9] represent benign hyperplasia.
